blockers.detail: No reviewed pcs3c_protocol_v1 JSON was supplied.
Scientific choices need an explicit review record before execution.
The sealed W1_CHOICE.json required by Part B is not available at a protocol-pinned path.
Part B gives only a suggested 1,600 pool and >=450 retained test states; exact pool/split counts, ordering, eligible-row selection, and the ordering of gates versus test sealing are not fixed.
The freeze requires at least 450 post-gate test states; pin the exact test allocation and enforce that floor before any test scoring.

The freeze says same RQ2c generator/prompt as PCS3, but PCS3 documents and the pinned runner differ in final-marker wording; the RNG namespace/code and exact prompt/parser identity are not sealed for the fresh seed.
PCS3c says exact-A-state oracle >=90%; older PCS3 supervised freeze additionally requires >=85% per selector. No reading is selected by this preflight.
The multiposition amendment fixes semantic positions but not an approved tokenizer-boundary mapping rule for source character offsets, saved greedy IDs, and teacher-forced prompt+trace positions.
The freezes name Qwen/Qwen3-4B and Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B but do not pin immutable model and tokenizer revisions or local artifact hashes.
The registered arms do not pin all receiver prompt/chat-template bytes, the choice among multiple matched wrong partners, the probe commitment seed, or the bootstrap seed.
No complete PCS3c source-generation/capture/gates/bridge/evaluation executor or Modal launcher is implemented; only pure helpers and synthetic smoke are available.
